meta.name: Tavola
meta.author: Sunnyside
meta.essence: Around the table · Coastal lunch in afternoon light
meta.promise: Sunlit coastal restaurant scenes carved from ivory linen, warm terracotta, blood orange zest and clear views of the dining room and sea.
meta.family: One sun arc, one table slab, one afternoon light beam.
meta.oneSentence: Tavola is an unhurried coastal Mediterranean dining identity: sunlit linen, warm terracotta, blood orange zest and an interlocking Kuwayama table mark.

theme.material: woven ivory linen tablecloth, sun-baked limestone terrace, glazed porcelain, terracotta pots and Tyrrhenian sea cobalt
theme.edge: precision organic: 8px–12px squircle radius with 1px tactile linen hairline borders
theme.offset: low Mediterranean afternoon sun shadow (0 12px 28px -6px rgba(34, 26, 21, 0.08))
theme.stroke: zero line icons; pure filled geometric vectors with crisp 45-degree angle light cuts
theme.tile: spacious 12-column asymmetric dining rhythm, generous margins, unhurried leading
theme.density: generous coastal dining rhythm (96px section padding, 24px cell padding)
theme.fieldRecipe: dappled terrace shade over woven linen with warm specular glass highlights
theme.markForm: semicircular solar arc rising over a horizontal cantilever table slab with a faceted pedestal
